summary: At the examined commit, js/uhitm.js:mhitm_adtyping stops at its AD_SLIM refusal instead of executing uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_slim. Port the whole source function in js/uhitm.js and wire the existing dispatcher across hero-to-monster, monster-to-hero, and monster-to-monster branches. The case follows the monster-to-hero branch. Preserve the source gates, RNG order, messages, slime transformation, death flags, and damage updates. In the monster-to-hero first-infection branch, potion.c:make_slimed() is a void, discarded-return helper with no full JS implementation; the source-gap rule permits note_unported('potion.c make_slimed'), but that leaves timed sliming and later behavior unresolved and may cause a later mismatch.

source.branch: Whole-function scope at uhitm.c:3526-3600. When magr == &gy.youmonst, handle hero-to-monster slime attacks: magic negation returns early; otherwise a 1-in-4 roll and !slimeproof(pd) enter munslime/newcham/death-flag handling and zero damage. When mdef == &gy.youmonst, handle monster-to-hero attacks: hitmsg first, then negation; otherwise flaming attackers burn slime away, Unchanging/noncorporeal/green-slime heroes are unaffected, and a not-yet-Slimed hero gets the infection message, make_slimed(10L,NULL), and delayed killer. The remaining branch handles monster-to-monster attacks with the same negation and 1-in-4/slimeproof gates, visibility-sensitive transformation messages, strategy/flag updates, and zero damage.

dependencies: uhitm.c:mhitm_mgc_atk_negated() returns the Boolean used by the negation gates; preserve its branch and RNG/message ordering.
rnd.c:rn2(4) returns the value used by the 1-in-4 conversion gates in the hero-to-monster and monster-to-monster branches.
include/mondata.h:slimeproof(), flaming(), and noncorporeal() are Boolean macros whose source predicates control slime immunity, burning, and hero immunity branches.
muse.c:munslime() returns whether the target took action; its result controls whether newcham() is attempted, and its effects may kill either monster.
mon.c:newcham() returns a Boolean tested by the source while changing the target form to PM_GREEN_SLIME.

do_name.c:mon_nam() and pmname() return text consumed by the hero-to-monster message and delayed killer name respectively.

potion.c:make_slimed() is void and its result is discarded. If left unported, record note_unported('potion.c make_slimed') and skip the call; this gap leaves the hero sliming timeout/status unresolved.
end.c:delayed_killer() is void; the monster-to-hero first-infection branch uses it to store the SLIMED killer after make_slimed().
